verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a feature-flag and experimentation platform, but the evidence pack never documents a GrowthBook CLI. The pack covers a REST API, an MCP server, SDKs and Docker Compose self-hosting. The 'command palette' (Cmd+K) is an in-app UI navigation feature, not a command-line tool. None of these are the named capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
